title: Microsoft Teams: manage built-in Teams agents from a dedicated admin centre page
notes: claim 59: severity blocker on a rationale: impact rating lowered to minor; ratings are judgements and cannot hold a page
the verifier wrote "hold" but listed no blocker and fewer than three majors; the claims decide, so the page is not held
summary: The admin paths, licensing statements and roadmap details are supported. The impact rationale still implies that restricting agent availability stops users seeing agents, although Microsoft says users not enabled for Channel Agent can still see its presence and messages. Availability must be described as controlling interaction, not visibility.
